title: Litmus: Zero-Label, Code-Driven Metric Specification for Evaluating AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.23403v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As agentic LLM systems move from prototypes to deployment, evaluating them has become more important and more difficult. Evaluation goals are often left implicit. Without a clear account of what a system is expected to do, how it can fail, and which failures matter, metric choices become difficult to justify, interpret, or validate. We present Litmus, a zero-label system that designs evaluation and monitoring metrics for AI pipelines by eliciting evaluation intent from source code and targeted interrogation. Litmus first identifies what must be measured and why, then converts those answers into constraints for a justified, per-stage metric portfolio. We evaluate Litmus on three real, code-defined pipelines against AutoMetrics and three DynamicRubric baselines. Litmus achieves broader concern coverage on account grouping at matched size, spans more stages, produces a near-zero-redundancy portfolio, and, under a zero-label design-time

translated_title: Litmus：面向AI系统评估的零标签、代码驱动的指标规范
translated_abstract: 随着智能体化的大语言模型（LLM）系统从原型走向部署，对它们的评估变得越来越重要，也越来越困难。评估目标往往是隐含的。如果没有清晰说明系统预期要做什么、可能以何种方式失败、以及哪些失败才是关键的，那么指标的选择就难以进行合理的论证、解释或验证。我们提出了Litmus，一个零标签系统，它通过从源代码中提取评估意图并进行有针对性的询问，为AI流水线设计评估与监控指标。Litmus首先识别需要测量什么以及为什么要测量，然后将这些答案转化为约束条件，从而构建一个有据可依的、按阶段划分的指标组合。我们在三个真实的、由代码定义的流水线上，将Litmus与AutoMetrics以及三个DynamicRubric基线进行了对比评估。在相同规模下，Litmus在关注点分组上实现了更广泛的覆盖，跨越了更多阶段，生成了近乎零冗余的指标组合，并且在零标签的设计时（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Litmus是一个零标签系统，通过从源代码提取评估意图并进行针对性询问，为AI流水线自动设计有据可依的分阶段评估与监控指标组合，其覆盖范围更广且冗余度接近于零，优于AutoMetrics和DynamicRubric基线。
en_tdlr: Litmus is a zero-label system that automatically designs justified, per-stage evaluation and monitoring metrics for AI pipelines by eliciting evaluation intent from source code and targeted interrogation, achieving broader concern coverage and near-zero redundancy compared to AutoMetrics and DynamicRubric baselines.
